water.name: Land
water.rule: At least 4 of the hex's 7 sample points (centre + 6) fall on province or neighbouring-country outlines, unless the centre is sea and the hex is mostly at or below sea level in ETOPO1. Islands of at least 3 km² (and every Hoàng Sa and Trường Sa island) keep at least the hex at their centre.

water.name: Sea
water.rule: Sea deeper than 200 m and not next to land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea next to a land hex, or shallower than 200 m (ETOPO1 mean).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Water hex with Natural Earth 1:10m lake points that outnumber sea points, or above sea level.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex under 70 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation ≥ 190 m, or mean elevation ≥ 1,500 m.

relief.name: Peaks
relief.rule: Highest sample ≥ 2,600 m with mountain relief (the Hoàng Liên Sơn range around Fansipan).

cover.name: None
cover.rule: Water, neighbouring countries, or no WorldCover land pixels.

cover.name: Broadleaf forest
cover.rule: Tree cover (10) is the largest group, mean elevation under 1,000 m.

cover.name: Montane pine forest
cover.rule: Tree cover is the largest group, mean elevation 1,600 m or more.

cover.name: Montane forest
cover.rule: Tree cover is the largest group, mean elevation 1,000–1,600 m.

cover.name: Pasture
cover.rule: Not used: WorldCover has no pasture class (grazing land is grassland).

cover.name: Cropland & paddies
cover.rule: Cropland (40: rice paddies, fields, plantations it can tell from forest) is the largest group.

cover.name: Wetland & mangrove
cover.rule: Herbaceous wetland (90) plus mangroves (95) is the largest group.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: Built-up (50) is ≥ 25% of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

cover.name: Barren
cover.rule: Bare or sparse vegetation (60: sand dunes, rock) is the largest group.

cover.name: Ice & snow
cover.rule: Snow and ice (70) is the largest group.

notes.water: Province outlines (geoBoundaries) and Natural Earth 1:10m country outlines don't meet exactly. A sea hex whose ETOPO1 mean is above sea level becomes land when at least 4 of its 6 neighbours are land, or when it touches both Vietnamese and foreign land. Hoàng Sa (Paracel) and Trường Sa (Spratly) islands are far smaller than a hex; each island group is shown by the hexes at its islands' centres, owned by Đà Nẵng and Khánh Hòa.
notes.relief: From ETOPO1 samples (~1.8 km apart, about 50 per hex) at or above -100 m. Water hexes are always flat.
notes.cover: From ESA WorldCover 2021, read at about 280 m pixels and sampled on a 1 km lattice inside each hex (about 160 points). Permanent water and no-data pixels are ignored; shares are of the remaining land points. Neighbouring countries and far-offshore islands have cover 0 (none). Perennial tree crops such as coffee, rubber and cashew are often classed as tree cover, so the Central Highlands look more forested than they are.
